name: auto-model
description: Picks the model per prompt with local rules: quick questions to Haiku, writing and explaining to Sonnet, building and fixing to Opus. Switches only while the context is small, so the prompt cache isn't wasted.

switchUnderTokens.title: Switch only under (tokens of context)
switchUnderTokens.description: auto-model changes the model only while the conversation is under this many tokens. A switch re-reads the whole conversation on the other model's empty cache, which costs more than it saves on a long chat.
